in_sanskrit.name: स्वरूप
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The inherent nature or essential form of a person or thing, often used to refer to the divine or cosmic manifestation of a deity.

in_hindi.name: स्वरूप
in_hindi.long_meaning: Switariya - स्वितरीय (Svitariya) in Hindi, is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Form, Appearance, Aspect'. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby boy, often used in Hindu communities for naming ceremonies.

in_tamil.name: ஸ்வரூப்
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஷ்வரூப் (Śvārūp) in Tamil, is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Form, Appearance, Aspect'. It is a unique and significant name for a baby boy, often used in Hindu communities for naming ceremonies.

in_telugu.name: శ్వరూప్

in_marathi.name: Swarup
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Form or figure
